answer: Proof of Burn functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating that agents destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Like a bridge connecting value to identity, this process acts as a river of scarcity, forcing an attacker to incinerate immense wealth to simulate a sonnet of distinct participants. By decoupling influence from virtual replication and tethering it to tangible capital destruction, the system makes the cost of identity fabrication economically prohibitive.
